text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios takes a sad-vibes loss. 
However, during the race, she felt Daiichi 
Ruby's crazily passionate feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after being told that... her eyes 
reflected nothing but how she ought to 
carry herself as part of the "family." A 
truly salty reaction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Mile CS. I should get 
to race Daiichi Ruby again! Time to build 
up my vibes until then!
